goal: Deduplicate repeated ResNet stage construction in model.py and extract ensemble KWTA aggregation into a named helper, improving modularity without altering network topology or forward semantics.
planned_code_changes: Add module-level _make_resnet_stage helper that builds a BasicBlock stage and returns (Sequential, updated in_planes)
Replace five class-local _make_layer copies with calls to _make_resnet_stage
Add type hints on the new helpers; no changes to layer counts, activations, or tensor ops
success_criteria: All existing unit tests pass (test_kwta, test_model_and_train, test_ensemble)
Smoke check: EnsembleMnistCNN and MnistCNN forward produce identical output shapes
rollback_plan: Revert mnist/src/model.py to restore the five inline _make_layer methods and inline EnsembleMnistCNN.forward KWTA block.
